title: Regular Languages
description: Work with regular languages and their right-linear grammars — enumerate the words generated by a grammar, derive a grammar from a language definition, and test word membership.

grammarToLanguage.title: Grammar → Language
grammarToLanguage.description: Determine which words a grammar generates.

languageToGrammar.title: Language → Grammar
languageToGrammar.description: Build a suitable grammar from a language given as a word list or compact pattern.

recognizeWord.title: Recognize Words
recognizeWord.description: Decide whether a given word belongs to a grammar's language.

grammarToLanguage.title: Grammar → Language (Breadth-first Enumeration)
grammarToLanguage.description: Enumerates the first words generated by a grammar using breadth-first search over its derivations.

languageToGrammar.title: Language → Grammar (Word List)
languageToGrammar.description: Creates a regular grammar from an explicit set such as L = {"ab", "abb", "abbb"} by combining the words into a prefix tree.

languageSetBuilder.title: Language → Grammar (Set-builder Pattern)
languageSetBuilder.description: Reads set-builder notation with exponents and conditions and directly derives a right-linear grammar that generates exactly this language.

recognizeWord.title: Recognize Word (Membership Test)
recognizeWord.description: Checks whether a concrete word belongs to the language generated by a grammar.

lectureGrammar1.title: Grammar → Language (Zeros Followed by a One)
lectureGrammar1.description: Read this right-linear grammar: words begin with at least one 0 and end with exactly one 1.

lectureGrammar2.title: Grammar → Language (Alternating Zeros and Ones)
lectureGrammar2.description: Read this grammar: strictly alternating zeros and ones, beginning with either symbol, with a minimum length of 1.

lectureLanguage1.title: Language → Grammar (A Single One Between Zeros)
lectureLanguage1.description: Find a grammar for this language: at least one 0, exactly one 1, followed by at least one 0.

languageDefault.title: Language → Grammar (Zeros, a One, Zeros)
languageDefault.description: The default word list of the Language → Grammar simulator: zeros, a single 1, then zeros (an open-ended pattern written with a trailing "..").

grammarToLanguage.title: Grammar → Language
grammarToLanguage.description: Read the production rules and determine which words the grammar generates.

languageToGrammar.title: Language → Grammar
languageToGrammar.description: Write a regular grammar whose rules generate exactly the given words.

applied.title: Applied Grammars
applied.description: Model real token formats such as integers and identifiers as regular grammars.

g2lFiniteBinary.title: Grammar → Language (Three-bit Words)
g2lFiniteBinary.description: Enumerate every word that can be derived by this grammar.
g2lFiniteBinary.goal: List the complete finite language L(G).

g2lTrailingZero.title: Grammar → Language (Ones between Zeros)
g2lTrailingZero.description: Determine the language generated by this grammar.
g2lTrailingZero.goal: Describe the infinite language and list its first words.

g2lEpsilonLoop.title: Grammar → Language (Recursion with ε)
g2lEpsilonLoop.description: List the derivable words when B is also allowed to generate the empty word.
g2lEpsilonLoop.goal: Enumerate the shortest words and account for B's ε-production.

g2lGrouped.title: Grammar → Language (Grouped Alternatives)
g2lGrouped.description: Resolve the grouped rules and enumerate the generated language.
g2lGrouped.goal: Read the parentheses as ordinary alternatives and list the words.

l2gZeroOnesZero.title: Language → Grammar (One 0, Some 1s, One 0)
l2gZeroOnesZero.description: Find a regular grammar that generates exactly these words.
l2gZeroOnesZero.goal: Write right-linear rules that generate 0 1ⁿ 0 for n ≥ 1.

l2gFourWords.title: Language → Grammar (Four Fixed Words)
l2gFourWords.description: Write a grammar that derives exactly this finite language.
l2gFourWords.goal: Generate exactly these four 4-bit words and nothing else.

l2gNestedZeros.title: Language → Grammar (Blocks of Zeros)
l2gNestedZeros.description: Construct a grammar that generates this language.
l2gNestedZeros.goal: Generate words of the form 1 0ⁿ 1 0ᵐ 1 with n, m ≥ 1.

appliedIntegers.title: Language → Grammar (Integers)
appliedIntegers.description: Write a grammar for valid integers: an optional minus sign and no leading zeros.
appliedIntegers.goal: Accept 0, 42, -100…, but reject 007 and a minus sign by itself.

appliedIdentifiers.title: Language → Grammar (Identifiers)
appliedIdentifiers.description: Write a grammar for variable names: a lowercase first letter followed by uppercase or lowercase letters, with no digits.
appliedIdentifiers.goal: Accept x, foo, myVar…, but reject uppercase letters or digits at the beginning.
